House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for a grant to Siengkane Lao MN.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SOUTHEAST ASIAN MUSIC FESTIVAL. +]

[+$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Siengkane Lao MN for a Southeast Asian music festival on the East Side of St. Paul. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for a grant to Siengkane Lao MN.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SOUTHEAST ASIAN MUSIC FESTIVAL.

$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Siengkane Lao MN for a Southeast Asian music festival on the East Side of St. Paul.
additions: $200,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Siengkane Lao MN for a Southeast Asian music festival on the East Side of St. Paul.
